title.en: How I became an engineer in Simple Rockets 2.
title.id: Bagaimana saya jadi insinyur di Simple Rockets 2.

desc.en: How a spaceflight sandbox taught me to see code: rockets, a space station, programs that fly themselves, and the concepts behind them.
desc.id: Bagaimana sandbox antariksa mengajarkan saya melihat kode: roket, stasiun luar angkasa, program yang terbang sendiri, dan konsep di baliknya.

desc.en: How a phone game and its logic processor led me into web development.
desc.id: Bagaimana game di ponsel dan logic processor-nya membawa saya ke web development.

title.en: The moment I stopped watching the chart.

desc.en: A note about trading, screen time, and learning that stepping away is part of the process.
desc.id: Catatan tentang trading, waktu di depan layar, dan belajar bahwa menjauh sejenak juga bagian dari proses.
